purpose: One frozen secondary reference-panel block and host/phage axis; train-only protein-family feature preparation, no interaction fitting
panel: Require completed frozen_secondary_reference_panel, exact external panel SHA, authenticated annotation join and reconstruction of every train/test/embargo block. Read no source phenotype CSV; panel label dictionary is not consumed for feature construction.
software_deviation: MMseqs18-8cc5c rather than paper-listed15.6f452; effective defaults retained in logs; v2 SEARCH alignment-mode3, clustering unchanged
timeout_rationale: Declared before secondary runs: complete reference annotation inventories contain 114719 host proteins, substantially larger than source phage pilots. Bounded 1800s per serial command; no retry or parameter change on timeout.
input_normalization: Use bound strict FAA parser; remove exactly one terminal stop, reject internal/double stops and invalid/empty proteins. Preserve sequence, input order and per-genome copies; unique neutral IDs distinguish train/query/control. Bind source normalized DNA, FAA/GFF and contig/protein inventories; never concatenate DNA.
training_boundary: Train/query genomes derive only from exact block train/test Sample IDs. No embargo-only genomes, target references or technical annotation controls admitted to training. Cloned lexicographically first training proteome is a separately named mapping-control query, never vocabulary training.
vocabulary: Complete training cluster member coverage and training self-query hit coverage. Rare families occur in >1 unique training genome. Consolidate identical train-only occurrence tuples. Save/hash vocabulary and assignments after step5 and before query-createdb step6.
assignment: Search query proteins only against all training proteins. Kernel retains float32 identity descending/evalue ascending/raw-first tie behavior and reports cross-family ties; binary OR projection preserves all zero rows.
mapping_control: Require every copied protein to match its training self-query best-family assignment and exact feature vector. Report nonzero status separately; a zero control alone is not failure. Empty axis vocabulary remains valid representation but ready_for_fitting=false. This criterion is an explicit adaptation from prior pilot nonzero-control gate.
reports: Vectors cover exactly training_genomes union query_genomes, control vector separate; artifact bindings list path/sha256; all8 commands must exit0 for completed status; effective logs/resource receipts retained.
plan_only: No external command and no output/workdir creation; planned/missing-prerequisite statuses never claim execution.
failure: Preserve completed raw outputs/ledger; no automatic rerun, dropped genome, cutoff change or fold search.
revision_reason: Technical identity-reporting repair after preserved v1 copied-proteome failure and fixed-context mode probes; frozen before any interaction-model fitting, without phenotype/native outcomes.
identity_semantics: Only the two SEARCH commands request --alignment-mode 3: aligned-residue sequence identity is computed for their --min-seq-id 0.4 criterion and downstream hit ranking, under unchanged seq-id/coverage defaults. Clustering retains its original --min-seq-id 0.4 score-based estimated-similarity parameter/default behavior; this is not an assertion of exact-identity clustering or exhaustive homology detection.
